overview.description: The YieldMax INTC Option Income Strategy ETF (INYY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund seeks to provide current income and capped gains on the Intel Corporation stock (NASDAQ: INTC) through a synthetic covered call strategy, collateralized by cash and US Treasurys. The actively managed fund uses both standardized exchange-traded and FLEX options. INYY was launched on Jun 2, 2026 and is issued by YieldMax.
